name: Grape Manifest
summary: At Northshire Abbey, the Grape Manifest records grapes recovered from Milly Osworth's vineyard after brigands seized the harvest. The fruit is bound for the abbey's cellars.

sections.title: A Record of the Harvest
sections.body: Milly Osworth tends a vineyard in Northshire Valley, where local farms help feed Northshire Abbey. Defias bandits seized the harvest, putting the abbey's supply of fresh fruit and fermentable grapes at risk. The Grape Manifest records the grapes reclaimed from the fields and their quantity, so the abbey's quartermasters can account for their stores and prepare barrels for fermentation.

sections.title: The Abbey's Cellarer
sections.body: Brother Neals oversees Northshire Abbey's food and drink, and he enjoys sampling its wine in the quiet of the bell tower. The manifest tells him the grapes are coming, helping ensure monks and visiting recruits have drink. For the abbey's brothers, each saved bushel is a victory for their stores and a blessing from the Holy Light.

faq.answer: The Grape Manifest is an inventory written by Milly Osworth that records the harvest recovered from her overrun vineyard. It tracks the fresh grapes being delivered to Northshire Abbey.

aliases: who do i give grape manifest to
faq.answer: Brother Neals receives the manifest. He oversees the abbey's food and wine stores and often samples vintages in Northshire Abbey's bell tower.

faq.q: Why were the grapes in danger?
faq.answer: Defias brigands descended on Northshire Valley and drove Milly Osworth from her vineyard, putting the harvest at risk and cutting off the abbey's fresh fruit until recruits intervened.

faq.q: What does Brother Neals do with the grapes?
faq.answer: Brother Neals uses the grapes to replenish the abbey's food stores and ferment fresh Northshire wine for the resident brotherhood and visiting defenders.

angles.text: For cooks, the manifest shows how field harvests supply the abbey's stores and help feed its monastic community.
As a human, you can see the early struggles of Stormwind's heartland: even monastic life and simple harvests need armed defense against roaming outlaws.
